text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This summer camp, we're focused on
devising a
special strategy to tackle the
coming autumn
Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: So, like, what's the plan for camp?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh? My speed? What about the pool?
choice_data_list: スピードを極めてみようと思う
choice_data_list_en: I want to take speed to the absolute limit.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Wait... they're not gonna have a pool
here when
the ocean's right there, huh?
Guess that's out the
window.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: What instructor?
choice_data_list: そして教えてもらう先生を用意した
そして教えてもらう先生を用意したよ
choice_data_list_en: And I've arranged a teacher to instruct you.
And I've arranged a teacher to instruct you.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Goooood morning! Time for early-day
training!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This is Sakura Bakushin O. She's making
a name
for herself as a sprinter.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Uh, no. It's, like, four a.m.—that's way too early. Even my trainer's half asleep.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hey, am I seriously gonna have to get up
this
early the whole camp? Like every
single day?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tosen Jordan is aiming to be faster than
anyone
at this year's autumn Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
So I want to focus primarily on speed
training. Of
course, sprints and medium
races put different
demands on the
body, but...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Speed isn't built in a day! If you truly
want to push
your legs to the limit, early
action is key!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Okay, let's gooo! Bakushin! Bakushiiiin!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Zooooom!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: She's so fast...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Given our current situation, Sakura
Bakushin O's
speed seems like exactly
what we need
nonetheless.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Whatever!
choice_data_list: 君も！バクシンバクシーン！！
貴方も！バクシンバクシーン！！

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: B-Bakushin, Bakushiiiiin...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I can't HEAAAR YOUUU! Bakushin,
Bakushiiiin!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: What?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oho! You've got some nice Bakushin in
that voice!
What about you, Jordan?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: BAKUSHIN! BAKUSHIIIN!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Huff... Wheeze... Jordan... Wait uuup...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
What are you so tired for? We're only
just getting
started!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
All that shouting... takes a lot... out of
me...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Pfff...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, our early-bird life—or rather,
summer
camp—has begun.
